en: Improved `/hooks`: a hook's detail screen now says what kind of hook it is and where to change it, instead of always pointing at settings.json, and the hooks-disabled, safe mode and managed-hooks-only notices each say what is happening in one plain sentence
zh: 改进 `/hooks`：hook 的详情界面现在会说明它属于哪种 hook、应在哪里修改，而不再一律指向 settings.json；hooks 已禁用、安全模式和仅托管 hooks 这三种提示也各用一句通俗的话说明当前情况
